lessons.title: Welcome to torch.nn 🧱
lessons.description: Learn about PyTorch's neural network module and the nn.Module base class.

lessons.title: Linear Layers: The Neuron Block 🧮
lessons.description: Understand nn.Linear, weights, biases, and how they form the foundation of every network.

lessons.title: Activation Functions 🔥
lessons.description: Introduce non-linearity with ReLU, Sigmoid, Tanh, and Softmax.

lessons.title: Your First Neural Network 🤖
lessons.description: Combine linear layers and activations to build a complete feedforward network.

lessons.title: Sequential & Containers 📦
lessons.description: Use nn.Sequential to stack layers elegantly and explore other module containers.

lessons.title: Custom Modules & Weight Init 🛠️
lessons.description: Create your own nn.Module subclasses and control weight initialization.
